title: Stand where you are cherished
summary: The Lord cherishes the humble child and keeps that heart close. Stay humble enough to be kept close and cherished.
takeaway: Stay humble enough to be kept close and cherished.
lifeApplication: At the mirror, after the silence, or before the proving message, soften the shoulders and speak to the Lord as one already being kept close.

source.shortMeaning: The Lord cherishes the humble child and keeps that heart close.
source.lifeApplication: Before proving your worth again, remember you are being cherished and kept close by the Lord.

evidence.coreClaim: The Lord cherishes the humble child and keeps that heart close.
evidence.turn: Hold onto this: stay humble enough to be kept close and cherished by the Lord.
evidence.practicalImplication: At the mirror, after the silence, or before the proving message, soften the shoulders and speak to the Lord as one already being kept close.
